sites.name: Way2Agribusiness
sites.description: Way2Agribusiness India Pvt. Ltd. (operating as Krishimitra) is a social enterprise founded in March 2014 in Bengaluru. It runs a 'Five for Five' ecosystem model covering inputs/machinery, market access, project execution, professional development, and AI-backed advisory, and operates the Way2Agritech and Way2Foods brands plus AI service platforms (Way2AgriIntel AI, Way2AgriPro, Way2Agribiz PMC).

pages.title: About Us
pages.description: Way2Agribusiness India Pvt. Ltd. is a social enterprise established in March 2014 that facilitates agricultural transformation into agribusiness, acting as a one-stop solution for farmers and agri-entrepreneurs via integrated advisory, market access, and input services delivered online and at APMC yards.
highlights: 'Five for Five' ecosystem model: inputs/machinery, market access, project execution, professional development, AI-backed advisory
Service platforms: Way2AgriIntel AI, Way2AgriPro, Way2Agribiz PMC

Start-up India registration, MSME status, FKCCI awards, Green Leaders designation
Trademark registrations, Agricultural Department approval, APMC trade license, FSSAI certification, GST registration

sites.name: Way2AgriIntel AI
sites.tagline: AI and data-driven insights for farmers and agribusiness
sites.description: Way2AgriIntel AI delivers AI and data-driven insights to farmers and agribusiness participants through five patented, integrated modules covering crop selection, machinery, market/price forecasting, crop diagnosis, and nutrient management.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Platform overview combining advanced modules to help farmers decide on crop selection, equipment investment, market timing, plant health, and nutrient management.
highlights: Modules: CropIntel, AgMachineX, AgriFBI, AgriClinic, NutriTracker, plus Soil Test and FieldIntel

pages.title: CropIntel
pages.description: AI/ML-driven crop selection tool, particularly for perennial plants, evaluating yield potential, weather suitability, market outlook, and challenges against land, soil, water, and market conditions.
highlights: Supports single and multi-crop selection with suitable varieties

pages.title: AgMachineX
pages.description: Farm machinery advisory that recommends equipment based on land size, crop choice, and budget, balancing cost-effectiveness with quality.
highlights: Crops covered: Paddy, Maize, Tomato, Sugarcane, Coconut, Arecanut, Coffee, Banana and more
Equipment: power weeders, chaff cutters, sprayers, brush cutters, coconut climbers, dehuskers, earth augers, power tillers, water pumps, chainsaws
Offers budget-friendly alternatives when constraints exist

pages.title: AgriFBI
pages.description: Market intelligence platform giving periodical price outlooks so farmers can decide what to grow, when to grow, and how to market produce for optimal price realization.
highlights: Covers 9 commodities: Coffee, Arecanut, Pepper, Coconut, Copra, Maize, Tur, Onion, Tomato
Standardized 'Report' with price outlooks and critical factors

pages.title: AgriClinic
pages.description: AI-powered crop nutrient management using ML models on soil composition, weather, and plant characteristics, plus image recognition to spot deficiencies and pesticide needs.
highlights: 13+ crops: Paddy, Maize, Tomato, Sugarcane, Coconut, Arecanut, Coffee, Banana, Papaya, Pomegranate, Cotton, Onion, Tur, Pepper

pages.title: NutriTracker
pages.description: Flagship nutrient management platform combining farmer profiles, application monitoring, and precision scheduling powered by the AgriClinic module.

pages.title: Patent
pages.description: Way2AgriIntel AI holds a 20-year Government of India patent protecting its five interconnected models and their hybrid AI + statistical + rule-based decision logic.
highlights: Protects CropIntel, AgriFBI, AgMachineX, AgriClinic, NutriTracker

pages.title: Soil Test
pages.description: AI-driven soil health analysis converting lab results into actionable crop nutrition strategies, integrated with AgriClinic and NutriTracker.
highlights: 14 parameters tested: pH, EC, OC, NPK, sulfur, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, B and more
Access via WhatsApp, mobile app, portal

pages.title: FieldIntel
pages.description: Farm management solution helping commercial farms transition to agribusiness through expert guidance, crop management support, product supply, and technology integration.
highlights: 8-step process: field visit, MoU, decision-enabling system, off-farm strategies, on-farm support, product supply, tele support, retainer services

highlights: Three service divisions: Way2AgriIntel AI, Way2AgriPro, Way2Agribiz PMC
